hypothesis: S/R FLIP + RETEST (J 07-21: 745.89 'S/R flipped' premarket; J 07-17: '13:50 is a nice break and then retest'): a battle-tested horizontal level breaks (close-through), price leaves, returns, and retests the level from the OTHER side; a confirm candle at the retest is the entry. Both directions: break-UP -> support retest -> CALL; break-DOWN -> resistance retest -> PUT.

level_source.engine: backtest/lib/watchers/level_memory.py LevelMemory (the LIVE engine's multi-day level perception layer). Level sets are NEVER invented.
level_source.snapshot_rule: Level set for day D = LevelMemory.levels_at(idx_prev) where idx_prev = the LAST RTH bar of the prior covered day within D's inventory-assigned source-file frame. Strictly prior-session data only (causal by construction; asserted in code).
level_source.min_memory_score_provenance: the key-levels producer's MIN_MEMORY=20 selection floor (documented in level_memory.py's ROLE_FLIP_MEMORY_THRESHOLD block); NOT tuned here.
level_source.role_init: level.role from the LevelMemory snapshot; intraday role thereafter evolves ONLY via this detector's close-through margin rule (grid knob 1).
level_source.note: RTH bars only (09:30<=t<16:00 true ET). Premarket bars are not in the caches' covered population; premarket-derived flips are therefore expressed as first-RTH-bar close-throughs (a gap through a level flips it on the first RTH close beyond margin).

detector_definition.flip: At bar i (close c), a level L with current role resistance flips to support iff c >= L + margin; role support flips to resistance iff c <= L - margin. Every flip cancels any unconsumed pending setup on that level and arms a NEW pending setup in the flip direction (BULL after break-up, BEAR after break-down).
detector_definition.leave_zone_requirement: After the flip bar, at least one bar FULLY CLEAR of the retest zone must print before a retest is valid (BULL: bar low > L + band; BEAR: bar high < L - band). Fixed, not a knob: without it the bar after every break trivially 'retests'.
detector_definition.retest: First subsequent bar whose low (BULL) / high (BEAR) enters [L - band, L + band]. Same-day only (flip and retest on the same session).
detector_definition.confirm_RETEST_CLOSE: The retest bar itself closes on the flip side of L (BULL: close > L; BEAR: close < L). Decision instant = that bar's close time (bar_start + 5min).
detector_definition.confirm_NEXT_BAR_CLOSE: The bar AFTER the retest bar closes on the flip side of L. Decision instant = confirm bar's close time. If the confirm bar itself is still inside the zone without confirming, it becomes the new retest bar (rolling); if it is clear above/below the zone without confirming, the setup returns to armed (a later zone re-entry may retest again).
detector_definition.one_entry_per_flip: A pending setup is consumed by its first confirmed entry; no re-entry on the same (level, flip) event.
detector_definition.same_bar_tiebreak: If multiple levels confirm on the same bar, take the one with the higher LevelMemory memory_score.
detector_definition.causality: Bar i decisions use bars <= i only. Assert-checked in code two ways: (a) every signal's referenced bar indices <= its decision index; (b) prefix-equality self-check: on sampled (day, cell) pairs the detector is re-run on every truncated prefix of the day and must emit an identical signal prefix.

grid_statement: 16 cells = 2 margins x 2 bands x 2 confirms x 2 directions. 4 knobs, <=18 cells per protocol. Band values echo the live vocabulary (TOUCH_TOL=0.20, CLUSTER_TOL=0.35 bracketed by 15c/35c); margins bracket LevelMemory's own BREAK_MARGIN=0.15 (10c/20c). Zones, never penny-exact.

fixed_execution_params.account: safe-2 (CORE-SAFE) via dojo sim_executor arm alias 'safe'
fixed_execution_params.strike: live V15_SAFE_TIERS (ATM at $2K) via fleet_executor._tiers_for_arm + strike_selection.pick_strike; side C for BULL, P for BEAR
fixed_execution_params.qty: min(3, risk_gate.max_affordable_qty(equity=2000, premium, safe params)); <1 => UNAFFORDABLE (excluded, disclosed)
fixed_execution_params.entry_fill: first OPRA 5m bar at/after the decision instant; entry premium = that bar's VWAP (option_pricing_real.bar_at_or_after convention)
fixed_execution_params.exit: the LIVE RIBBON_RIDE shape via sim_executor._resolve_exit_shape(safe-2, 'ribbon_ride', None), walked by backtest/lib/exit_manager_walk.walk_exit_manager (the REAL production exit_manager decision core). structure_stop_enabled=True for all cells; trigger_level = the flipped level's price (side C exits on closed 5m < level; side P on closed 5m > level -- exactly the S/R-flip invalidation). Ribbon 'stack' from backtest/lib/ribbon.compute_ribbon over the full continuous source-file frame (proper EMA-48 warmup). time_stop from automation/state/params.json (15:50). Entry-side tuning ONLY; no exit knob varies across cells.

population.signal_days: all covered days (386), each processed inside its inventory-assigned source_file frame (dedupe honored; no cross-file row mixing)
population.gate_math_days: OPRA days only (381), REAL fills only; BS-synthetic fallback episodes are flagged is_synthetic, excluded from all gate math, and disclosed separately
population.held_out: the inventory's heldout_days list (last 25% of OPRA days by date, 96 days). Touched ONLY by gate 4 / held_out_total after the single frozen grid pass; never used to select or adjust anything.
population.first_day_per_frame_skipped: a day with no prior covered day inside its own source-file frame has no level snapshot and emits no signals (disclosed in results).

gates.gate_2: tuning day majority: fraction of tuning days with >=1 real fill whose day P&L > 0 exceeds 0.5
gates.gate_3: survives ex-top-1: tuning total_pnl minus the single best trade > 0 (ex_top3_total additionally reported)
gates.gate_4: held-out positive: >=1 real held-out fill AND held_out_total > 0
gates.p_raw: two-sided one-sample t (normal approx) of tuning per-trade P&L vs zero; reported, not a gate
